v3_mission: v2 시그니처(#F2F2F2 회색 배경, 옐로우 5~12% 액센트, 좌측 반쪽 알약 타이틀, 1Q26 빨강 사각 테두리, MAU 단일 옐로우, 음수 회색+빨강 라벨, 직각 모서리)를 100% 유지한 채 소스 15장을 10장으로 1:1 미러 압축.

color.no_shadow: drop-shadow strictly forbidden — separation is by fill contrast and 1pt hairlines only

yellow_hierarchy.#FDD000: 표지 'kakao' 로고타입 전용. 비비드 옐로우. <0.5% 면적.
yellow_hierarchy.#FBE100: 차트 주력 막대 + 표 헤더 + MAU 마지막 분기 단일 강조. 5~10% 면적.
yellow_hierarchy.#FAE232: 슬라이드 타이틀 반쪽 알약 배경 전용. 약 2% 면적. #FBE100보다 살짝 연한 위계 1단계 다운.

display.fallback: Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Inter, sans-serif

pill_title.treatment: lives inside yellow half-pill (#FAE232), left-padded 6% of slide width, vertically centered. Format: '메인 타이틀' or '메인 | 서브' or '메인 / 보조'. 본문 슬라이드 2~9에 8회 등장.

metric_callout.treatment: first line beside chart — '1Q26 +16% YoY, -10% QoQ'. Numbers bold, YoY/QoQ slightly downweighted.

mau_headline.treatment: slide 9 only — '4천9백만 명 규모의 견조한 국내 월간 활성 이용자(MAU) 유지'. MAU 헤드라인에서만 한글 풀이 1회 괄호 동행 허용.

thanks_headline.treatment: slide 10 only — '감사합니다' centered on white canvas

body.marker: ▪ (U+25AA small black square) + 1em space, hanging indent

data_label.treatment: directly above bar top (total) and inside stack segment (segment value + %). Format '1,022 (58%)'. Negative values ONLY use #FF0000.

data_label_total_bold.use: stack bar total value above the topmost segment; also MAU last bar (1Q26) label

table_rate_italic.use: rate rows (영업이익률, 당기순이익률, 매출액 대비) and YoY/QoQ columns

table_special_keyword.use: 흑자전환, Flat, 이연 — italic + bold black, no color tint

bottom_right_wordmark.position: body slides 2~9 bottom-right margin, BLACK (unlike cover where wordmark is yellow #FDD000)

page_number.position: centered, very bottom of slide (~96% y), body slides 2~9 only
page_number.format: number only — no dash, no brackets (2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9)

spacing.grid: informal split — left chart ~50% + right metrics/bullets ~45%, OR left table 50% + right table 50%, OR full-width chart+table (slide 9 MAU), OR 60/35 asymmetric (slide 5 inset). No strict 12-col snap.

shape.radius_default: 0px (square corners — bars, tables, boxes ALL right-angle)
shape.radius_pill_title_only: half-pill — left edge flat at slide x=0, right side full half-circle cap. Width 26% × height 8%.
shape.border: 1pt #BFBFBF hairlines only on table row separators and x-axis baseline; NO outer borders on tables, charts, or boxes
shape.shadow: FORBIDDEN — no drop shadows, no soft shadows, no ring pulses. Separation by fill contrast only.

current_quarter_red_box.spec: 1.5~2px solid #FF0000 rectangle wrapping the current quarter (1Q26) table column body. Header (yellow fill) is excluded — border starts below header at first body row.

slide.background: #F2F2F2 light warm gray (NOT white) for body slides 2~9. Slide 1 cover: top half #F2F2F2 + bottom half #C1E9F3 sky blue. Slide 10 thanks: #FFFFFF white (intentional contrast).
slide.grid: Standard zones: (1) yellow half-pill title at top-left (x=0, y=3%, w=26%, h=8%); (2) top-right caption '1Q26 Earnings Release' (#7F7F7F); (3) main content zone y=12~92% — split per page; (4) footnotes 1)/2)/3) below content; (5) centered page number at bottom; (6) bottom-right 'kakao' black wordmark. Slides 1, 10 exempt from footer marks.
slide.yellow_budget_per_slide: 5~12% of slide area for body slides. Title pill ~2% + chart accent bars 3~10% + table header 2~3%. Slide 5 runs at ~4% (porters page emphasis-light + entertainment inset). Cover ~1% (logo only). Thanks 0%.

chart.data_encoding: Bar fills are warm-neutral or signal: #BFBFBF light gray (secondary), #7F7F7F dark gray (single-color emphasis when blue/yellow not used), #99CCFF light blue (tertiary category), #FBE100 kakao yellow (PRIMARY METRIC SIGNAL ONLY). Color-category mapping is NOT fixed across pages — emphasis category gets yellow per-page.
chart.bar: RIGHT-ANGLE square bars, corner radius=0. Bar width 50~60% of slot width (gap_ratio ~0.4). Stacked bars use stacked rectangles, also square corners.
chart.line: Combo chart line is 1.5px DASHED line in #007ABF (dash 8px - gap 4px) with 6×6px solid SQUARE markers in #007ABF at each data point. NEVER rounded line caps, NEVER smooth curves. Optional values printed beside markers in black.
chart.donut: Not used in this style. Avoid donut charts entirely.
chart.axis: X-axis only — 1pt #000000 thin black baseline with short ~3px black ticks at each category. NO y-axis line. NO horizontal gridlines. NO chart bounding box.
chart.value_label: ALL values printed directly ABOVE bar top (total) and INSIDE stack segments (value + %). Format: '1,022 (58%)'. Color: #000000. Negative values: red #FF0000. Total label: 16pt Bold. Segment label: 13pt Regular.
chart.legend: Compact inline legend ABOVE chart or chart-top-left — small 12×12px color squares + 12pt category text. Line legend: dashed line + square marker mini-icon. NEVER a boxed legend with border.
chart.render: SVG precise. NO 3D. NO gradient fills. NO rounded bars. NO grid background. NO data shadows. NO color gradients in a single segment.
chart.stacked_bar_order: Per-page editorial choice — emphasized category goes YELLOW (top OR bottom of stack), supporting categories go gray/light-blue. Color-category mapping is gravity-free.

single_color_bar_palette.gray_when: 커머스, 포털비즈, 픽코마 — neutral or external-condition categories
single_color_bar_palette.light_blue_when: 플랫폼 기타, 뮤직, 미디어 — secondary categories

chart.negative_bar: Bar hangs BELOW x-axis baseline, fill #BFBFBF gray. Data label #FF0000 red. Examples: -36/-42/-46/-46/-55 (slide 7 AI), -47 (slide 7 4Q25 net income).

latest_quarter_yellow_signature.rule: In long timeseries (9 bars, MAU), final bar (1Q26) is solid #FBE100 yellow while preceding 8 bars are #BFBFBF gray. Final bar value label is 16pt BOLD. Other 8 labels regular 14pt.
latest_quarter_yellow_signature.appears_on: slide 9 (MAU). Table below chart: last column cells (국내·글로벌 1Q26) tinted #FEF9D6.

chart.label_voice: Korean-English mixed IR analyst voice. KEEP English abbreviations: YoY, QoQ, MAU, CapEx, OPM, GMV. KEEP financial vocab: 흑자전환, Flat, 이연, 계절적 비수기. NEVER convert to friendly long-form ('월간 활성 이용자' style is BANNED in this pack except slide 9 headline 1-time parenthetical pairing).

table.primary_style: Conservative IR analyst table — compact, NO outer border, yellow header row, gray subtotal shading, zebra body rows
table.header_row: Fill #FBE100 yellow, text #000000 700 bold 14pt, all column headers (구분 | 1Q25 | 4Q25 | 1Q26 | YoY | QoQ)
table.subtotal_row: Fill #BFBFBF dark gray, text #000000 700 bold 13pt. Use for: 매출, 플랫폼 부문, 콘텐츠 부문, 영업비용, 영업이익, 당기순이익 합계/소계
table.rate_rows: 영업이익률·당기순이익률·매출액 대비 etc. — italic + #7F7F7F muted gray, 13pt
table.no_outer_border: Tables have NO bounding border. Only inner row hairlines #BFBFBF 0.5pt if needed.
table.current_quarter_red_box: Wrap the entire current-quarter (1Q26) column body cells in 1.5~2px solid #FF0000 rectangular border. Header (yellow) is excluded from border — border starts at first body row. Slide 6: 2 occurrences (실적요약 + 영업비용 tables side by side).
table.negative_in_table: Negative numbers stay BLACK in tables (just minus sign: -47). Only CHART negative labels turn red. Different rule than chart.
table.special_keywords: 흑자전환, Flat — italic + bold black, no color

diagram.language: There is NO custom diagram language in this style. Communication happens through (1) tables, (2) bar/line charts, (3) ▪ square-bullet body bullets. No process flows, no node graphs, no Before/After cards, no comparison panels, no KPI cards with icons.
diagram.process_flow: Not used. If a process must be shown, render as a numbered ▪ bullet list with bold step names.
diagram.timeline: Not used. Quarter timeseries are shown via the bar chart x-axis (1Q24, 2Q24, ... 1Q26) with 'Latest Quarter Yellow' signature.
diagram.comparison: Not used as Before/After cards. Comparison is done via a SINGLE table with 1Q25 | 4Q25 | 1Q26 | YoY | QoQ columns and red box on 1Q26.
diagram.kpi_card: Not used. KPIs live as metric callouts BESIDE charts (16pt bold first line + ▪ supporting bullets) or as the title hero of a chart slide (e.g., '4천9백만 명 규모의 견조한 국내 MAU 유지' headline above MAU chart).
diagram.icon_container: Not used. NO icons in IR body slides. Character illustrations appear ONLY on cover (slide 1) and thanks (slide 10). IR body pages (slides 2~9) are 100% chart/table/text.
diagram.section_divider: Not used. There is no full-bleed section divider. Section grouping happens only via the pill title text (e.g., '플랫폼 부문 | 톡비즈' pipe, '영업이익 / 당기순이익' slash).
diagram.render: Almost no SVG diagrams. Charts and tables ARE the visual language.

imagery.characters_forbidden_on: all IR body slides (slides 2~9). v3 reduces character pages from v2's 3 (cover + ESG + thanks) to 2 (cover + thanks) by dropping the ESG slide.
imagery.style_if_used: Korean friendly mascot illustration (rounded, flat-fill, brand-mascot style). Since the pack license bans kakaofriends direct use, use a generalized friendly mascot or omit.
imagery.no_3d_isometric: FORBIDDEN — no 3D, no isometric, no glassmorphism, no glow, no gradient overlay.
imagery.no_custom_icons: FORBIDDEN in body. Even category indicators are text-only labels, not icons.
imagery.esg_screenshots_dropped_in_v3: v2 had an ESG page with external infographic collage. v3 drops it — external screenshot collages conflict with the IR body visual idiom.

slide.transition: Subtle. Slide cuts only — no whoosh, no bounce, no parallax, no scale. The dashboard cleanliness is the message; motion would betray the conservative analyst tone.

page_mirror_plan.compression_strategy: 1:1 mirror for 8 core pages, 2→1 merge for slides 5 and 6, 3 source pages dropped (disclaimer, music/media single chart, ESG external collage).

mappings.signature: 8 gray bars + last 1 yellow bar — MAU sigil

dropped_source_pages.p-02_disclaimer: Full-text disclaimer — yellow 0%, no signature, low diversity contribution. Out of 10p scope.
dropped_source_pages.p-08_music_media: Light-blue solo bars for 뮤직 + 미디어. Absorbed into slide 6 summary table rows (뮤직 438/525/485, 미디어 75/96/92).
dropped_source_pages.p-13_esg: External infographic collage (ISS Stoxx Prime / 4대 과기원 / KAKAO COMPLIANCE PROGRAM / LET'S CP). External screenshots conflict with IR body visual idiom — dropped in v3.

pages.label: 표지 (kakao 옐로우 #FDD000 로고 + 캐릭터 하단 절반 #C1E9F3)
매출 구성 (좌 5분기 옐로우/회색 스택 + 우 옐로우 헤더 매출구성 표)
부문별 매출 (좌 플랫폼 + 우 콘텐츠 100% 스택, 색 가변 할당)
플랫폼 부문 | 톡비즈 (상 광고 옐로우 + 하 커머스 회색 + 우측 ▪ 메트릭)
플랫폼 | 포털·기타 (다크그레이 + 라이트블루 + 엔터테인먼트 옐로우 인셋)
실적요약 / 영업비용 (좌·우 분할 표 2개, 둘 다 1Q26 빨강 사각 테두리)
영업이익 / 당기순이익 (옐로우 스택 + AI 음수 회색+빨강 + OPM 점선 콤보)
인원 / CapEx (회색 인원 + 옐로우 CapEx 무형자산 + 매출액 대비 점선)
카카오톡 MAU (9개 막대 중 마지막 1개만 옐로우 — 단일 시그니처 클라이맥스)
감사합니다 (흰 캔버스 + 중앙 검정 본고딕 + 우하단 마스코트)
